description: Changes an existing plan (outline, cut-outs, board, design, substructure, options). Only given fields change. Returns the new material list and price.

board.description: Decking board. Use an id from list_board_options; otherwise kind and colour pick the closest offer.

colour.description: Board colour name from list_board_options (e.g. Anthrazit, Grau). Omit for the board's own colour.

kind.description: massiv = solid profile, hohlkammer = hollow, hohlkammer_3d = hollow with embossed wood grain.

cutouts.description: Openings in the deck (tree, planter, shaft). Replaces existing cut-outs when given.

widthM.description: Width, or the diameter of a circle.

design.description: Laying design: direction, frame, zones with divider boards, steps. Only given parts change.

direction.description: laengs = boards parallel to the house wall (x), quer = away from the house (y), diagonal = 45°.

colour.description: Board colour name from list_board_options (e.g. Anthrazit, Grau). Omit for the board's own colour.
Board colour name from list_board_options (e.g. Anthrazit, Grau). Omit for the board's own colour.

widthM.description: Step width (at most the length of that edge).

axis.description: x = zones side by side, y = zones behind each other.

colour.description: Board colour name from list_board_options (e.g. Anthrazit, Grau). Omit for the board's own colour.

direction.description: laengs = boards parallel to the house wall (x), quer = away from the house (y), diagonal = 45°.

share.description: Divider position as a share of the extent along the axis.

strip.description: LED strip under the edge finish.

name.description: Short plan name, e.g. 'Terrasse Garten'. No personal data (names, addresses, e-mail).

objects.description: Garden objects planned with the deck (replaces all). We do not sell them; the planner lists their quantities as site work ('Bauseits').

alongEdge.description: Glass fence / screen: lay it along the nearest outline edge.

sunk.description: Pool only: sunk into the deck (default) or standing.

edgeTrim.description: Edge trim on the open sides (default true).

outline.description: Deck outline in metres. x runs along the house wall (left to right), y away from the house (y = 0 is the house edge, 'back'; the largest y is 'front').

depthM.description: Rectangle depth away from the house (y).

points.description: Polygon corners [[x, y], ...] in metres, in order. Use for L, T, U shapes, cut corners.

planId.description: planId returned by create_terrace_plan (valid 30 days from creation).

substructure.description: Unterbau: what the deck stands on.

edgeFinish.description: Open sides: auto (board cladding once more than 5 cm sit below the substructure, else trim), trim (Abschlussleiste), boards (side cladding from deck boards on battens), none.

ground.description: slab = existing concrete/paving, pedestals = adjustable pedestals (Stelzlager) on paving, footings = concrete point footings, ground-screws.
